parts.t: Brookswood Gem! Step into this beautifully updated home with vaulted ceilings. Situated on a private 10,123 sq. ft. lot, it offers 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, and a separate 1-BEDROOM LEGAL suite. Large windows flood the main floor with light, and the gorgeously renovated kitchen is perfect for entertaining. Enjoy a spacious deck and patios leading to a serene yard. Ample parking is available for an RV and other recreational items, along with 2 storage sheds. Recent upgrades include new flooring, a renovated kitchen, updated appliances, A/C, a new laundry room, and  the Exterior of the house has been recently PAINTED! Centrally located, this home is near parks, walking trails, Noel Booth Elementary, and Brookswood Secondary.
